The HWPX intake summary automation succeeded by correctly mapping XML namespaces and table structures to the required output format.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00, with the pytest suite in test_output.py passing all assertions. Success was driven by robust handling of the HWPX zip-based XML structure, though future iterations should remain cautious of hardcoded table indices if document templates vary. The final output matched the expected schema, confirming that the logic for extracting clinic-specific metadata from the internal content.hwpml file is reusable.
